roomSummary: Spacious open-plan living and dining area leading into a rear kitchen, featuring dark carpeting, large side windows, and a pre-installed TV mount.
camera: The camera stands at the front of the main room looking toward the dining zone and kitchen in the background.

landmarks.description: Black TV wall mount on the right wall
Large window with curtains along the left wall
Peninsula bench separating kitchen and living areas
Wall-mounted heat pump high on the rear wall above the kitchen boundary
White interior door at the rear right next to the kitchen
Curtains flanking the left foreground window edge

walls.name: Right wall
walls.description: Solid white wall holding the TV bracket

walls.name: Left wall
walls.description: Long wall dominated by a central window and draped curtains

walls.name: Rear wall
walls.description: Contains kitchen cabinetry, heat pump, and entry door

zones.name: Living Zone
zones.description: Foreground and midground area centered around the TV bracket on the right wall

zones.name: Dining Zone
zones.description: Midground area in front of the kitchen peninsula bench and left window

zones.name: Kitchen Zone
zones.description: Rear right section behind the peninsula bench

layout.placement: Mounted directly on the black TV wall bracket on the right wall, concealing it
Low profile console placed against the right wall directly under the mounted TV
Three-seater sofa facing the right wall, set in the central foreground
Placed atop an area rug directly in front of the sofa
Angled inward on the far side of the rug facing back toward the sofa
Rectangular dining table with four chairs placed in the midground space between the kitchen peninsula and the left window

relationships: The dining suite sits behind the sofa back and before the kitchen peninsula.
The living seating faces the right TV wall, preserving a central walkway from the entry toward the kitchen.
avoid: Do not place the dining table between the sofa and the TV wall.
Do not block access to the kitchen peninsula or the rear door.
Do not position furniture that obstructs the left wall windows or curtains.
keepUntouched: Black TV bracket position (covered by TV)
